According to {{WebCite|url=https://www.animatetimes.com/news/details.php?id=1787282569|text=『スター・ウォーズ：ビジョンズ／九人目のジェダイ』神山健治総監督＆多田俊介監督インタビュー｜「スター・ウォーズ」を日本人が作る理由ーージェダイとライトセーバーに秘められた侍の精神を改めて描く|date=2026-08-21|work=[https://www.animatetimes.com アニメイトタイムズ]|language=[[Wikipedia:Japanese language|Japanese]]|archivedate=20260823054754}}, the director [[Shunsuke Tada]] stated that the events of ''[[Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi]]'' are envisioned as taking place 200 [[Standard year|years]] after the era in which [[Luke Skywalker]] lived. Since ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates Luke Skywalker's [[death]] to [[34 ABY]], the events of {{#switch:{{{1|}}}|1="[[A New Threat]]|2="[[A Hidden Weapon]]|3="[[Voice From the Past]]|4="[[Nawaam Attacks]]|5="[[The Storm of Violence]]|6="[[Light of the Force]]|7="[[The Jedi Strike Back]]|8="[[The Ninth Jedi (episode)|The Ninth Jedi]]|''Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi''}}{{#if: {{{1|}}}|{{#if: {{{2|}}}|," including {{{2}}},|"}}|{{#if: {{{2|}}}|, including {{{2}}},|}}}} must take place around [[234 ABY]].<noinclude>[[Category:Canon television dating citation templates]]
